name: record-trivia
description: Record and music trivia in Claude Code: a card above the prompt while Claude works, and a scored game in the chat

webTrivia.title: Trivia from the internet
webTrivia.description: Mix in music quiz questions from Open Trivia DB and album facts from Wikipedia.

pointsRight.title: Points for a right answer
pointsRight.description: Added to your score for each right guess.

pointsWrong.title: Points off for a wrong answer
pointsWrong.description: Taken off your score for each wrong guess.

pointsClose.title: Points off for a close answer
pointsClose.description: Taken off instead of the full amount when a guess is close (a year off by one, a near spelling, part of the answer).

pointsRightWithHint.title: Points for a right answer after a hint
pointsRightWithHint.description: Earned instead of the full amount when you asked for a hint first.

rotateSeconds.title: Seconds per card
rotateSeconds.description: How long each card shows above the prompt while Claude works: the question for the first half, the answer for the second.
